symptom_tags.wrong_prices: Product or promotional prices display incorrectly
symptom_tags.gateway_auth_401: Payment gateway returns HTTP 401 (wrong key/credentials on the gateway side)
symptom_tags.provider_outage: Payment provider outage confirmed on the provider side

incidents.title: NovaStore - wrong payment gateway key
incidents.root_cause: Payment gateway used the wrong key for the active environment (HTTP 401 from the gateway) after the provider changed the test environment.
incidents.resolution: Approved update of the gateway key; transaction test passes.

quotes.speaker: Kamil
quotes.text: Checkout reports authorization errors, but the product prices are correct. The payment provider has just changed the test environment.

quotes.speaker: Marek
quotes.text: In the payment gateway logs: HTTP 401. Our gateway is using the wrong key for the active environment.

incidents.lesson: A checkout authorization error with correct prices was a gateway key problem, not to be linked automatically to other checkout errors.

incidents.title: NovaStore - incorrect promotional prices
incidents.root_cause: Incorrect rule in the discount plugin after the promotion schedule changed.
incidents.resolution: Rule corrected, prices back to normal; checkout worked throughout.

quotes.speaker: Patrycja
quotes.text: Promotional prices are wrong on the product page, but actual payments go through without errors.

quotes.speaker: Marek
quotes.text: The cause is an incorrect rule in the discount plugin after the promotion schedule changed.

incidents.lesson: Wrong promotional prices alone, with working payments and no Salesforce issue, pointed at the discount plugin rule.

incidents.title: NovaStore - payment failures and wrong prices
incidents.root_cause: Expired Salesforce API access token used by the CRM Bridge plugin; the integration failure showed up in prices and checkout.
incidents.resolution: With the Incident Lead's approval the integration was temporarily disabled (staging test first), checkout test succeeded; then authorization renewed and CRM sync restored and verified.

quotes.speaker: Marek
quotes.text: In the CRM Bridge logs we have repeated auth_failure responses and the message access token expired. That is a log from our Salesforce integration, not a 401 returned by the gateway.

quotes.speaker: Ola
quotes.text: On staging, after temporarily disabling the Salesforce plugin, the prices returned to normal and the test order went through. That is strong evidence of a dependency, but in production we act in a controlled way.

quotes.speaker: Ola
quotes.text: Cause confirmed: the Salesforce API token used by the CRM Bridge plugin expired. Interim fix: isolate the plugin, then safely re-authorize and restore synchronization.

quotes.speaker: Kamil
quotes.text: We're adding a checklist: checkout fails plus wrong prices -> check integration logs and expired tokens, not just the payment gateway. Ola is the runbook owner.

incidents.lesson: A payment failure does not have to mean a gateway failure; when prices are also wrong, check plugin dependencies and integration logs.

incidents.title: NovaStore - payment provider outage
incidents.root_cause: Outage on the payment provider's side, confirmed by the provider's public status; no CRM Bridge log errors.
incidents.resolution: The provider restored the service; the shop's integration was not changed.

quotes.speaker: Marek
quotes.text: The provider's public status confirms an outage of their API. No errors in the CRM Bridge logs.

quotes.speaker: Marek
quotes.text: The provider restored the service. We did not change the shop's integration.

incidents.lesson: Failed payments with correct prices and a confirmed provider outage were not a shop-side problem.

incidents.title: NovaStore - 503 from the reverse proxy
incidents.root_cause: Backend overload behind the reverse proxy after a deploy.
incidents.resolution: Faulty deployment rolled back per procedure; service responds correctly.

quotes.speaker: Patrycja
quotes.text: The whole shop returns HTTP 503, you can't even open the cart. This is not an error of the payment itself.

quotes.speaker: Marek
quotes.text: The reverse proxy indicates backend overload after a deploy. We are rolling back the faulty deployment per procedure.

incidents.lesson: A whole-site HTTP 503 was a deployment/overload issue with no connection to the Salesforce token.

incidents.title: NovaStore - delayed CRM synchronization
incidents.root_cause: Long processing queue delaying synchronization of new contacts to Salesforce; Salesforce authentication was active.
incidents.resolution: Synchronization throughput increased; there was no sales outage.

quotes.speaker: Ola
quotes.text: In Salesforce we see a delay in synchronizing new contacts. Checkout and prices in WooCommerce work correctly.

quotes.speaker: Marek
quotes.text: The processing queue is long, but authentication to Salesforce is active.

quotes.speaker: Ola
quotes.text: We increased the synchronization process throughput. There was no sales outage.

incidents.lesson: A CRM sync delay with working checkout and prices was a queue throughput issue, not an auth failure.
